snippet.title: 100 Africa Cats // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3495020/100_Africa_Cats/

🐾 Join the cutest adventure in the 🐘🦒 AFRICA 🦁🌞, full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of themed locations as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Can you find them all? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

Developed by
100 Cozy Games 
and
Cats
